title: Honed Blades
problem: Each creature adds 15% of every other ally's artifact % bonus for that stat to its own % bonus. All slots that give the stat count, dual-stat slots included. It shares the bonus percentage, not part of the other creature's stat value. Health is not shared, as the text says.
notes: Text: Your creatures share 15% of their Artifacts' bonuses from {STAT_attack}, {STAT_intelligence}, {STAT_defense}, and {STAT_speed} with each other. This trait does not stack. Evidence: crit_attack gate @0x1417b93c6; bc_GetAlliesOf(c, false, false) @0x1417b946a (self excluded); 5 x inv_ArtifactStatTotal @0x1417b996b-0x1417b9a29 (props 1/54/58/59/60); 0.15 @0x1417b9a5b. Same in crit_defense @0x1417cb766, crit_intelligence @0x1417defcb, crit_speed @0x1417f2697. Reasoning: 'Share 15% of their Artifacts' bonuses' is what the getters do; artifact stats are percentage bonuses. Counting the dual-stat slots fits 'bonuses from Attack…'. Nothing to fix. App note (unpatched game): Honed Blades gives each creature 15% of the other creatures' artifact % bonuses (dual-stat slots included) as a % bonus of its own. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26).
